description: Datadog monitors for Video Classrooms (LiveKit). All monitors target Prometheus-style metrics exposed by the NestJS backend via OpenMetrics and ingested by the Datadog Agent.

monitors.name: [Video Classrooms] No active rooms
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No active video classrooms in the last 10 minutes. This could indicate a LiveKit connection failure, a token generation issue, or zero user engagement.

**Actions:**
1. Check LiveKit server health at the SFU endpoint.
2. Verify the LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY, and LIVEKIT_SECRET configuration.
3. Check video-calls/* API error rates.
4. Review LiveKit server logs for connection issues.
{{/is_alert}}

monitors.name: [Video Classrooms] High participant count
[Video Classrooms] Room creation error rate spike
[Video Classrooms] Room creation latency spike
[Video Classrooms] Room join activity dropped to zero
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No video classroom join events have been recorded in the last 10 minutes. This could indicate a complete outage of the video call feature or zero user engagement.

**Actions:**
1. Check the video-calls API health endpoint.
2. Verify the LiveKit server is running and reachable.
3. Check for deployment or infrastructure incidents.
{{/is_alert}}
